## Deltas from ticket

- **`delete data[windowId]`**: it deletes the key named after the window id's value (`data.w1`), so stored entries keep their `windowId`. Pinned as is. I don't think it meant `delete data.windowId`: `initAsync()` in `src/controller/Base.mjs` compares `currentHash.windowId === windowId`, which needs the entries to keep it.
- **Noted, not pinned**: a read without a `windowId` before any push creates `stacks.undefined`, which then counts as "the first window". After a later push for `w1`, `first()` returns `undefined` and `getCount()` returns 0. `RuntimeService.getRouteHistory()` takes an optional `windowId`, so it can reach this. I can file it as its own ticket if you want it fixed.
- The reset is a `test.beforeEach`, not repeated in each test.

## Test Evidence

Outside CI, a mutation check. Each defect, re-injected into `src/util/HashHistory.mjs`, fails the test aimed at it:

| one stack for all windows | each window has its own stack; read without a windowId |
| `delete data.windowId` | the `delete` test |

| `push` instead of `unshift` | 5 tests |
| previous entry taken from `stack[0]` | change event arguments |
